MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (3T only): spatial field gradient ≤ 19 T/m; B1+RMS of 1 uT or less; WB-SAR ≤ 1 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode; Limit total active scanning to 20 min; A cooling period of 60 minutes is required between scans; Body transmit coil only.
Image artifact: up to 25 mm.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
